a.text: The man steps into the room. The woman in the wheelchair utters not a word.
He tidies up the notes and documents scattered across the table.
He swaps the withered flowers in the vase out for fresh ones.
She continues reading her newly borrowed book, as if she takes no notice of him.
Perhaps because all there is to say has long since been said.
Or perhaps because it is not yet time for that which shouldn't be said.

steps.name: Wasting Man
steps.text: She'll be back soon.

steps.name: Quiet Woman
steps.text: The Legati spent so long preparing for this meeting. Of course she will.

steps.name: Quiet Woman
steps.text: How long will you stay?

steps.name: Wasting Man
steps.text: Until I finish what I must do.

steps.name: Wasting Man
steps.text: For all I can accomplish here is the delivery of the Lateran people's souls.

steps.name: Wasting Man
steps.text: I should go.

steps.name: Quiet Woman
steps.text: Don't come back.

a.text: The man stands silent for a while, before turning and leaving the room.
The woman pushes her wheelchair up to the window.
She opens it, and looks out.
She's watched the sun rise and set over Laterano countless times through this window frame.
The city is as noisy as ever tonight, the Laterans being strangers to both tranquility and exhaustion.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma, drink some hot water.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Good girl, *cough* *cough*... Mamma's alright.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma... I'll read you a storybook.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Cecelia, my darling Cecelia.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Mamma really hates to leave you.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Are you going to leave me, Mamma?

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: No, *cough* *cough*... Mamma's never, ever wanted... to leave you...

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: She's just got no choice...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Where are you going, Mamma? Can I go with you too? Is that okay?

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: You can't go where I'm about to go, Cecelia... It's very cold, very lonely, and so, so empty.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'll go with you, I'll be with you so you won't be lonely.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, Cecelia.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Your childhood should have been so much more blessed...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I HAVE been blessed. With you, Mamma.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Cecelia... Cecelia. Listen now, listen.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'm listening, Mamma.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: I won't be able to look after you soon... Someone will come pick you up.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Go with him. He'll take you to Papà.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Papà will look after you for me, okay?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Can't you come with me? I bet Papà really wants to see you...

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Mamma... has something important to do... So I can't go with you.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Once you see Papà, tell him that your Mamma really misses him too.

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Also, tell him... I'm sorry. Okay?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma, what are you sorry for?

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Listen to me, listen to your Mamma, Cecelia!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I will, Mamma... Don't cry...

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Cecelia, my poor Cecelia... Giving birth to you was the greatest blessing in my life. But what if you find it a lifelong curse... my child, my beloved daughter...

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Who will bless you? Who can?

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Cecelia, my darling Cecelia... Hide yourself. Don't let them find you...

steps.name: Sickly Mother
steps.text: Run away... leave Laterano...
The mother holds her daughter's hands. Through her eyes flash myriad emotions, until finally all strength fades from them.
And they slowly, gently fall shut.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma...?
The Sankta girl does not know what's happened.
When she notices her mother's hands have turned cold, she clasps them together against her own chest, hoping to provide some warmth to her.
There's a knock on the door.
Executor Federico of the Laterano Notarial Hall, on official business. Please open the door.

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Sir, your check-in at the guesthouse has been taken care of.

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: The rest of your day is completely free! Might not be a bad idea to have a look around. You seemed quite eager the whole way.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Hmm—

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Lateran City has some very distinct architecture.

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: You see? Wasn't it worth the trip?

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: I suppose it was.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: What's the schedule for tomorrow?

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Your meeting with His Holiness the Apostle, our Pope, is all set, so I'll be returning to the Basilica now. I'll fetch you tomorrow when it's time to meet him.

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Please enjoy your stay in Laterano during the conference. No need to worry about expenses; it is our honor to host VIPs from the world over.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: The world over... *sigh* I sure don't see how gathering all these foreigners in one place is gonna get anything done.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Still, how could I refuse such a generous invitation from His Holiness? Might as well take advantage of his hospitality while I'm here.

steps.name: Cheery Legatus
steps.text: Excellent, now if you'll excuse me. Feel free to take Laterano by storm.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: The architecture here sure is interesting. Columbia uses pillars like these too, but there're subtle differences...

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Hmm. Seeing as I'm here...

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Hm? What are they up to over there?

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: All set up?

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I'm good. How's your end?

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Done. Ezell, have we dispersed everyone in the area?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: All the citizens likely to be directly affected, yes. Those in the secondary effect range are confirmed to be notified as well.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Shall we get started then?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Mm-hm... Current time is 10:22, on March 15th, 1099. The following act of demolition is carried out with Reserve Executor Ezell of the Notarial Hall as witness.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Alright. Here goes, three—

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: (What're those three Sankta doing standing around that pillar?)

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Two—

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: You three are the only ones around here. What gives?

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: One, fire!—Huh, where'd you come from?!

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: What?! What was that explosion?! ...Something's coming down!

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Save me, save me! Eeeek—!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I have to... what? The pillar's falling a lot slower now...

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Save—
Cram it.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Eeek—

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Huff... huff...

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Th-That scared the skin off of me! What kind of crazy place is Laterano?! Whoever you are, Liberi, thank you for rescuing me.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: What's your name? Find me at the Columbian Provisional Association, and I'll return the favor.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She's called Shimmering Vigil.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Shimmering Vigil...? Lateran names sure do sound silly sometimes...

steps.name: Shimmering Vigil
steps.text: That's not my name.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Hi... you're okay, right?!

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Thanks, you two. That could've been a disaster.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Thank you for your aid.

steps.name: The Liberi Formerly Known As Shimmering Vigil
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Say, what's going on here though? Bombings in the middle of the day? Don't tell me you have extremists sneaking in?

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Something's been on my mind.

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Do you think this pillar is absolutely perfectly positioned, or no?

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I would say so; it fully embodies Laterano's architectural aesthetics. So?

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: So... I can't help but wanna see what would happen if we blew it up.

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Ahh—

steps.name: Sedate? Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I have to admit, it's a fine idea.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: But the conference is starting soon, right? I heard there'll be a lotta people from afar. I think His Holiness even said we should show some restraint for a while.

steps.name: Sedate? Lateran Citizen
steps.text: He did.

steps.name: Sedate?? Lateran Citizen
steps.text: However, he said 'show some restraint', not 'don't do anything'.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I get that His Holiness is hoping to give the visitors a good impression. But, my dear friend, what do you say to my humblest of opinions? I think a 'good impression' must be based on reality.

steps.name: Not Very Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: You couldn't be more correct, my friend.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: So, we filed with the Notarial Hall, got our executor here to witness for us, and evacuated everyone nearby...

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Before giving this beautiful pillar just the perfect blast...

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Except, we never expected you to show up right at that moment.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: We're so sorry, esteemed sir, for unwittingly doing you harm.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: You... set off an explosion on a nomadic city street? And filed with the government... for an official witness?! Were you... you Laterans always this... uninhibited?

steps.name: The Liberi Formerly Known As Shimmering Vigil
steps.text: Of course we abide by the Commandments and all relevant regulations.

steps.name: The Liberi Formerly Known As Shimmering Vigil
steps.text: But if it's not explicitly forbidden, anything's fair game. And Lateran City values and protects every citizen's rights.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Don't worry, sir. Just your average everyday explosion, perfectly normal.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: What if someone gets hurt...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We know our limits. That said, I'd also like to extend my apologies to you for this accident.

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Truly sorry, sir.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Maybe it hasn't quite sunk in for you yet, but believe me, stay long enough and you'll learn to love this city.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Er... I think I can live without that sinking in.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And there you have it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Welcome to Laterano, sir.
Tut-tut, if it isn't Mostima. Just what is her ability? Is she slowing down time, or merely tricking people into perceiving it that way?
It blows my mind every time.

steps.name: Reserved Legatus
steps.text: Oren, what's going on over there?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Not much, just a normal day in my lovely hometown.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Though I did get a better show than expected.

steps.name: Reserved Legatus
steps.text: The others are waiting for us.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I know. Let's go.
The Legati.
A special Messenger division established under the auspices of the incumbent Pope.
Laterano had previously held a detached position, maintaining neutrality among the central powers.
As such, Lateran officials were sometimes tasked by foreign powers with relaying critical information between different parties in the course of diplomacy.
This role was normalized and institutionalized with the establishment of the Legatus system. They have become a special force moving between the nations.
With Laterano's absolute neutrality as a foundation, the Legati aim to promote the circulation of important information between countries.
1098: via the Legati, the Pope sends an invitation to all nations of Terra:
'Gather for a conference at Laterano. I invite every nation to dispatch its envoys for a discussion regarding our collective security.'
1099: the Legatus system celebrates its thirtieth anniversary.
In March of that year, Legati from all across Terra proceed for Laterano together with the envoys of numerous nations.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: One of those two just now seemed a lot like a Pontifica Cohors, and the other... was that a Legatus?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: A strange combination.

steps.name: Brisk Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Ezell, are you gonna stick around now that your witness work's done?

steps.name: Sedate Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Don't worry, we'll rebuild the pillar as good as new, just like we wrote in our application.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Good, I'll leave you to it then. I'll be going now, I've still got quite a bit on my plate.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Er. Just to confirm, I'm looking for a will registered by someone who's... passed away?
A typical single woman's residence, with no trace of any other occupants.
In the bedroom, her body lies serenely. No signs of poisoning, no signs of violence.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Federico here.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Female citizen's body discovered at 7-265 Via Thervatius, Pagus Stevonus.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Preliminary determination of the cause of death: natural. Please notify the Ecclesia Requietum of the pagus to come and inter the remains.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Preliminary search found no last will and testament. Please initiate new assignment: confirm deceased's identity, search for will according to any pre-registered information.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Federico out.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma...
Don't go out.
Don't let anyone else find you.
Never, ever approach anyone in uniform.
That's what Mamma said.
Is the uniform man gone? Or still here?
It's alright. When someone visits, just take a nap on your little sofa, just like always. You can go back to Mamma when you wake up.
Don't panic... Cecelia. Why are you so worried?
Why can't you fall asleep?
It's okay, it's okay... you just need to wait for the stranger to leave.
It'll all be alright when you're with Mamma again.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Seems things went pretty well in Sargon, huh? They sent out a whole bunch of envoys.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: Don't get me started. The pashas are all eager enough, but the problem is none of them can agree on anything.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: I'm already thanking Heaven they haven't started brawling yet.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: What about Kazimierz? Their military's sizeable, no matter how you slice it.

steps.name: Calm Legatus
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi turned down our proposal, but the K.G.C.C. was actually very interested.

steps.name: Calm Legatus
steps.text: One rep even sought me out.

steps.name: Calm Legatus
steps.text: We had a long chat... he understood the international situation as well as any Legatus.

steps.name: Calm Legatus
steps.text: He might even come in person, if he's not too busy.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: But enough about us. How about you, Oren?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: The situation in Victoria is anything but simple these days. I'm sure you've heard a thing or two.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Duke Gododdin and I get along fine, but... it's less that he doesn't want to appoint anyone to be here, and more that he CAN'T.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Everything's balanced on a knife's edge, more or less.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: Yan didn't dispatch anyone either. Not that they didn't send a stream of gifts 'conveying our thanks to His Holiness'... How very Yanese of them.

steps.name: Calm Legatus
steps.text: Kjerag actually sent out a few, after rising to prominence these last two years... and every other nation's envoys are already here.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: To be honest, I never imagined this job would go so smoothly.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Scared?

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: A little bit.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You haven't been a Legatus for too long, if I remember right.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: Less than four years, I guess.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But our organization has been active for thirty years now.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: After all our efforts, I'd say every last one of us has earned these results.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Besides, we're still a long way off from what we're hoping for—a true 'Summit of Nations', right?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: We need more than envoys showing up in the Lateran Basilica audience hall. We need the people in power, the ones who can actually change things.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: So save your nerves for the day we have to greet the big guns instead.

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: Thanks for putting it like that—now I've got no idea if I should be excited or terrified.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: I see you can't stop yourself from terrorizing the newbies, Oren.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You wound me.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Nothing to get keyed up about, even if that day really comes.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: That's what we're qualified for, aren't we?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Maybe so.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: So, are the acting Legati of each region all present?

steps.name: Reluctant Legatus
steps.text: We're only missing Mostima.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Mostima? Ooh, I just happened to see her.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: What's she doing?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Right now? Taking in her native air again.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Ah, forget her. We were never counting on her to come anyway.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: She can report to His Holiness last and we're good, just like always.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Sanctitas advenit.
In a split second, the hall is silent and still.
All of the Messengers' gazes lie on one spot.
The teacher of all Laterano, their guide, their spiritual leader—

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Good morning, children. Have you had breakfast yet?

steps.name: Pious Sister
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Stoic Sister
steps.text: No sign of external force. It was likely due to illness.

steps.name: Pious Sister
steps.text: A pitiable soul. May she not ail so on the other side.

steps.name: Stoic Sister
steps.text: Dimming Sankta, your remains shall be conferred unto the Ecclesia Requietum, where you shall rest.

steps.name: Pious Sister
steps.text: Here, this was hung on the bedroom wall. Hand it to a member of the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Why did they take Mamma away...?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: What... do I do...?
Cecelia casts her gaze to the entrance.
You can't go out, you can't be found... or else you'll be in danger, Cecelia.
That's what Mamma said.
But if Mamma got taken away, will she be in danger too?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fiammetta...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Wait, you're actually using my name for once? What gives?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Aw, you don't like it? More a fan of 'Shimmering Vigil', then? Or do you want a new one?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Fiammetta's fine, thanks. Seriously though, what is it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Say... my lovely coworkers should be in the Lateran Basilica right about now, no? Reminiscing about me, maybe?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If you're aware, then maybe you should show your face for once.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Nah, forget it, I'll never get used to the ambience in there.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Besides, who'd want to see a living warning sign rock on in there? They'd just be uncomfortable.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Since when do you care if other people are uncomfortable?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm not so bored I'd make myself unwelcome just for fun.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Objection: case in point. I'll admit you're enjoying being back here a lot more than I expected, though.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: 'Welcome to Laterano' and all that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ah, I think I'm just in high spirits. Probably from coming home after so long.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Yeah right.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hahah, sure, whatever, let's go.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Where to?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: To see her, of course.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, maybe she's in a different hospital now?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: It's been ages since the last time you returned, after all.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Follow me.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I haven't been to this pagus too often. It seems not too far from the outskirts... I should be nearly there, right? 7-265, Via Thervatius...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Is that an... Ecclesia Requietum hearse stopped by that door?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hello? Excuse me, Sister!

steps.name: Stoic Sister
steps.text: Calm down, young executor.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Have you finished the inspection already?

steps.name: Pious Sister
steps.text: Correct. There was a Sankta who departed us by illness.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: May I quickly verify the remains?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Confirmation complete. The deceased is the homeowner Feoria La Porta.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: My assignment mentioned no will was discovered nearby. May I ask if you noticed anything resembling one during your inspection?

steps.name: Stoic Sister
steps.text: We did not. However, this is for you... the Notarial Hall would wish to reclaim it, correct?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Is this... her patron firearm? Understood, I'll take it back with me. Thank you both.

steps.name: Pious Sister
steps.text: If you're done with the identity check and arms reclamation, please allow us to convey her to the Ecclesia Requietum.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ah, very well. Thank you for your time.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Identity of the deceased confirmed. If I want to find any pre-registration of a will through the Notarial Hall system... Right, I can do a long-ranged search from my terminal...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Census addresses... homeowners...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Er, she didn't prepare a will?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: The diagnosis record states...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ah, given the illness, giving up on hospital treatment makes sense... but why wouldn't she leave a will...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hm...? Is that a neighbor's child? Why is she hiding from me...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Wha—did she faint? But why? She only tripped...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Does anyone know who this child's parents are?! Does she live nearby?

steps.name: Troubled Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I've never seen her before. Is she passed out...? What if she bumped her head when she fell?

steps.name: Composed Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I've never seen her either. Maybe she just moved in? I can ask around at the neighborhood hall.

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: What for?! If she's hit her head, then we need to get her to the hospital!

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: You hurry and take her there, executor. We live just around here. If her parents come looking, we'll point them straight to the hospital to find you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Perfect, thank you all!

steps.name: Lateran Citizen?
steps.text: Grr... I didn't think Cecelia would run straight into a Notarial right outside her home...

steps.name: Lateran Citizen?
steps.text: What now, Patia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: What else? Follow them, make sure she's safe... and get her out of the Notarial Hall's hands!
